identity.name: Star Island
identity.hoa_name: Palm Hibiscus Star Islands Association, Inc. (PHS Islands Association)
identity.notes: Star Island is a small, exclusive man-made residential island in Biscayne Bay within the City of Miami Beach, completed in 1922 by the Army Corps of Engineers (land initially owned by developer Carl Fisher). It features a fixed supply of approximately 30-35 single-family waterfront estates, is part of the Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve, is known for high-profile/celebrity residents, and has been named the most expensive neighborhood in the United States by Bloomberg L.P. Access is via a single guard-gated bridge; it lies south of the Venetian Islands and east of Palm and Hibiscus Islands, with access to Miami Beach and downtown Miami via the MacArthur Causeway.

fees.note: Specific fee amounts and structures are not publicly detailed in available sources. Traditional monthly or quarterly HOA dues are reportedly not applicable; residents contribute to shared security and maintenance supported by the Palm Hibiscus Star Islands Association (HOA established 04/23/1998, per florida-hoa.net; managed by FPMS, Sarasota FL). Treat fee levels as uncertain/unverified.

amenities.detail: Guard-gated access via a single bridge with private security; low-density, secure setting with association-supported security and upkeep across Star, Palm, and Hibiscus Islands.
Buoy Park located on the island; shared amenities are limited, with focus on private estate features.
Tennis courts at nearby Palm Island Park (adjacent Palm Island) — not on Star Island itself.
Basketball courts at nearby Palm Island Park (adjacent Palm Island) — not on Star Island itself.

Palm Hibiscus Star Islands Association board is responsible for collecting dues and ensuring facilities and common areas are well-managed, maintained, and attractive (association supports security, landscaping, and community upkeep).

No commercial amenities on the island; residents use nearby South Beach and mainland Miami for shopping and services. Guarded gate with restricted public access and on-site security are provided at the MacArthur Causeway entrance. Law enforcement jurisdiction is the Miami Beach Police Department, with relatively few reported incidents compared with the broader city. Climate is tropical monsoon: hot humid summers (88-92°F), warm winters (70-76°F), most rainfall May-October, hurricane season June 1-November 30 peaking August-September; vulnerable to storm surge and seasonal coastal flooding. Property taxes, insurance, and maintenance costs are described as consequential given very high property values and maintenance costs, but no specific fee amounts are stated on the page.
Luxurious homes are fitted with swimming pools, among other modern conveniences (per article dated July 13, 2016).
Luxurious homes are fitted with hot tubs.
Luxurious homes feature large landscaped gardens.
Star Island is located in Biscayne Bay, famous for its water sports and yachts.
